title: Translates of an integer multiplicity action depend continuously on the translation
statement: Let P, j ∈ ℕ and let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an integer multiplicity triple in ℝ^P (R : IMRep univ j, with M = R.carrier, θ = R.mult, ξ = R.orient, H^j := μHE[j]). Let η : ℝ^P → Λ^j (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) j) be a continuous j-form with compact support. Then the function t ↦ R.action(y ↦ η(t + y)) = ∫_M θ(y)·ξ(y)(η(t + y)) dH^j(y) is continuous on ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P j : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) j) (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) j), Continuous η → HasCompactSupport η → Continuous (fun t : Euclid P => R.action (fun y => η (t + y)))
